title: Blood Manipulation
subtitle: Drawing on what is already there
text: Manipulation is the act of giving form to what already lives in the blood. It does not create power from nothing: it directs power that was always present, seeded by the infection and bound to a temper. Memories are ranked HUMILIS (first learning), MEDIOCRITAS (practiced), SUMMA (mastered), and above them MAGISTER and PERFECTUS, which only the Loom weaves. Most are cast on R, and they are typed: QUICK (a single act), PASSIVE (always active), CONTINUOUS (active while held), or CHARGED (building toward release). Many also sculpt a verb: with the memory selected, held Projection or Absorption does that memory's work on what you aim at, and a combat memory puts out a strand. A few have nothing to cast and work only through the verbs. Every casting and every held pulse costs blood and burns a little of its school's Temper. Temper never refuses: run dry and the work still goes, costing more blood and landing softer. A memory's price shows on its tooltip and on the HUD while it is selected. Each is bound to a vein section, and that section bears the strain. The eight pages that follow list the memories of each school.
